# LogiRapid API Documentation

> LogiRapid is a logistics and shipping platform API. This documentation covers authentication, orders, tracking, and webhooks.

## Base URLs

- Production: https://logirapid.com/api
- Sandbox: https://sandbox.logirapid.com/api

## Authentication

LogiRapid uses JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication. After logging in, you receive a token valid for 7 days.

### Header Format
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>
```

## User Roles

| Role | Description |
|------|-------------|
| SUPER_ADMIN | Full access to all platform functions and companies |
| ADMIN | Company administrator, can manage users and settings |
| MANAGER | Can create users, recharge wallets, no transfers |
| USER | Standard user, can sell services and debit from wallet |
| DRIVER | Driver, access to assigned routes and deliveries |
| WAREHOUSE | Warehouse staff, inventory management |

---

## Endpoints

### POST /auth/login

Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns a JWT token.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "your_password"
}
```

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "user": {
    "id": 42,
    "name": "Jane Doe",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "role": "ADMIN",
    "companyId": 3,
    "companyName": "Mi Empresa"
  }
}
```

**Response 400:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Email y password son requeridos"
}
```

**Response 401:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Credenciales incorrectas"
}
```

**Response 403:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Usuario inactivo"
}
```

---

### POST /auth/logout

Closes the current user session. Requires Authorization header.

**Headers:**
- Authorization: Bearer {token} (required)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true
}
```

---

### GET /auth/me

Returns information about the authenticated user. Requires Authorization header.

**Headers:**
- Authorization: Bearer {token} (required)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "user": {
    "id": 42,
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "role": "ADMIN",
    "companyId": 3,
    "companyName": "Mi Empresa",
    "phone": "+1234567890",
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
    "lastLogin": "2024-03-20T14:22:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Response 401:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "No autorizado"
}
```

---

## Error Codes

| Code | Name | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| 400 | Bad Request | Invalid or missing parameters |
| 401 | Unauthorized | Token not provided, invalid, or expired |
| 403 | Forbidden | No permission to perform this action |
| 404 | Not Found | Requested resource does not exist |
| 409 | Conflict | Conflict with current resource state |
| 422 | Unprocessable Entity | Invalid data sent |
| 429 | Too Many Requests | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Internal Server Error | Server error |

---

## Coming Soon

### Orders API
- POST /orders - Create order
- GET /orders/:id - Get order
- PUT /orders/:id - Update order
- DELETE /orders/:id - Cancel order

### Tracking API
- GET /tracking/:code - Track package
- GET /tracking/:code/history - Get tracking history
- GET /tracking/:code/location - Get current location

### Webhooks
Events: order.created, order.shipped, order.delivered, order.failed

---
